source.original_text: Let (Ω,Σ,μ) be a probability space, let I be a finite nonempty index set, and let X:Ω→Mat_I(ℝ). Give real matrices the Euclidean operator-norm topology and use the Bochner integral and matrix-algebra power-series exponential. Suppose X is almost-everywhere strongly measurable, X and the ordinary matrix square X² are integrable, X=Xᵀ almost everywhere, I−X is positive semidefinite almost everywhere, and ∫X dμ=0. Then for every real s>0, exp((exp(s)−s−1)∫X² dμ)−∫exp(sX) dμ is positive semidefinite. The explicit regularity hypotheses expand Tropp§2.2 standing expectations. The claim is the real normalized individual-matrix form of Lemma6.7.

# 数学重构

## 对象与所有定义

概率实验由样本空间 Ω、其给定的 σ-代数和概率测度 μ 构成。令 I 表示签名中的有限非空指标类型 ι，令 n=|I|；这里 n 只是解释矩阵大小的记号。随机对象 X 把每个 ω∈Ω 映为一个 I×I 实矩阵。X(ω)² 指矩阵乘积 X(ω)X(ω)，其 (a,b) 元为 ∑_{c∈I}X(ω)_{a,c}X(ω)_{c,b}，不是把每个矩阵元素平方。

为叙述结论，记 V=∫_Ω X(ω)² dμ(ω)，α(s)=e^s−s−1，以及 M_s=exp(α(s)V)−∫_Ω exp(sX(ω)) dμ(ω)。这些记号是本重构引入的缩写；输入本身没有 let 绑定。V 的 (a,b) 元为 ∫_Ω∑_{c∈I}X(ω)_{a,c}X(ω)_{c,b} dμ(ω)。所有积分均为所给有限维实矩阵空间中的 Bochner 积分。实数 e^s 使用标量指数函数；矩阵 exp(A)=∑_{m=0}^∞ A^m/m!，其中 A^0=I_n、其余幂用通常矩阵乘法。标量 s 和 α(s) 乘矩阵时，乘的是每个矩阵元素；矩阵指数本身不是逐元素指数。

## 取值域

Ω 是任意给定的可测空间；μ 是其上的概率测度，故 μ(Ω)=1。I 是任意具有有限枚举、可判定相等关系且非空的类型；n≥1。所有矩阵属于 M_I(ℝ)，所有检验二次型的向量属于 ℝ^I。矩阵空间使用有限维实欧氏算子范数拓扑，概率积分和几乎处处语句均相对于 μ。参数 s 是实数。签名中的 universe 参数仅决定承载类型的宇宙层级，不增加数学约束。

## 量词

对每一个可测空间 Ω、每一个在其上的概率测度 μ、每一个这样的有限非空指标类型 I，以及每一个满足下一槽全部假设的映射 X:Ω→M_I(ℝ)，对每一个实数 s>0，都有下一结论。μ、I、X 可以任意选取，但在评价这个 s 的结论时固定。结论中正半定性要求对每一个实向量 v∈ℝ^I 检验二次型。两条几乎处处假设分别各自在 μ-几乎处处的 ω 上成立；它们的零测例外集合不必预先相同。

## 明确假设与推导性质的边界

签名明确给定以下假设：

1. X 相对于 μ 几乎处处强可测，即存在一个强可测函数，与 X 在 μ-几乎处处相等。
2. X 是 μ 下 Bochner 可积的矩阵值函数。
3. ω↦X(ω)X(ω) 也是 μ 下 Bochner 可积的矩阵值函数。
4. 对 μ-几乎每个 ω，X(ω)^T=X(ω)。实矩阵的 IsHermitian 在这里就是对称性。
5. 对 μ-几乎每个 ω，I_n−X(ω) 正半定。完整展开为：I_n−X(ω) 自伴，并且对每个 v∈ℝ^I，∑_{a,b∈I}v_a(δ_{a,b}−X(ω)_{a,b})v_b≥0；δ 是单位矩阵的元素。这是矩阵的上界 X(ω)≼I_n，不是逐元素不等式。
6. ∫_Ω X(ω) dμ(ω)=0，其中右边是零矩阵。
7. s>0。

除可测结构、概率测度及有限非空指标结构外，没有额外的独立性、分布、维数大小、下谱界或逐元素界假设。第 5 条没有直接给出 −I_n≼X(ω) 或 ‖X(ω)‖≤1。签名也未单独给出 ω↦exp(sX(ω)) 的可积性假设。由对称性、平方可积性及积分性质可以推出 V 对称且正半定；由 s>0 可以推出 α(s)>0。这些是可推导性质，不是额外列出的假设，也不是把结论替换为这些性质。

## 结论

矩阵 M_s 正半定，即

exp((e^s−s−1)∫_Ω X(ω)X(ω) dμ(ω)) − ∫_Ω exp(sX(ω)) dμ(ω) ≽ 0。

完整地说，M_s^T=M_s，并且对每个 v∈ℝ^I，∑_{a,b∈I}v_a(M_s)_{a,b}v_b≥0。因此也可写作 ∫_Ω exp(sX(ω)) dμ(ω)≼exp((e^s−s−1)V)，其中 ≼ 是由完整正半定性定义的矩阵序。结论是上述整个矩阵差的正半定性，没有取迹、行列式、最大特征值、逐元素比较或概率尾界。它针对一个随机矩阵 X 及其二阶矩，不包含多个随机矩阵的求和。

## 作用域与运算解释

μ 同时控制几乎处处强可测、两条可积性假设、两条几乎处处矩阵假设以及全部积分。每个积分中的 ω 是绑定的样本变量。矩阵乘法中的求和指标 c 和二次型中的 a,b 是有限集合 I 上的局部绑定指标。s 在整个结论内固定，且在积分之外；没有把 s 作为随机变量。符号 1 在 I_n−X 中是单位矩阵，标量表达式 e^s−s−1 中的 1 是实数一；0 在均值假设中是零矩阵。没有条件分布、条件期望、权重重定义或未展开的 let 对象。本重构引入的 V、α(s)、M_s 只缩写已显示的表达式，不改变其作用域或量词。

## 常数依赖

数值常数 0 和 1 固定；矩阵单位元及零矩阵的大小由 I 决定。α(s)=e^s−s−1 只依赖 s；V 由 Ω 的可测结构、μ、I 和 X 决定，并不依赖 s；M_s 由这些对象和 s 决定。不存在额外的未指定常数、隐含维数因子、可优化参数或依赖某个未给定分布的常数。

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinExponential
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral

/-! The real normalized single-matrix expectation MGF step of Tropp Lemma 6.7.
Regularity expands his section 2.2 standing convention. This is not a sum tail.
-/
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator MatrixOrder
noncomputable section
universe u v
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinMgf

private lemma capped_matrix_exp_norm_le
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hcap : (1 - A).PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ‖NormedSpace.exp (s • A)‖ ≤ Real.exp s := by
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint A := hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hspec : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, x ≤ 1 :=
    (CFC.le_one_iff (R := ℝ) A hSA).mp (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hcap)
  have heq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) A = NormedSpace.exp (s • A) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc Real.exp (s • A) := cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hSA
      _ = _ := CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp ((IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul hSA)
  rw [← heq]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_nonneg s)
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hspec x hx) hs.le

private lemma exp_sub_one_add_posSemidef
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (NormedSpace.exp A - (1 + A)).PosSemidef := by
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint A := hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hfc : cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) A ≤ cfc Real.exp A :=
    cfc_mono (a := A) (fun x _ => by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x])
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hlin : cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) A = (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) + A := by
    rw [cfc_add (a := A) (fun _ : ℝ => 1) (fun x : ℝ => x) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      cfc_const (R := ℝ) 1 A hSA, cfc_id' ℝ A hSA, map_one]
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mp
    (by simpa only [hlin, CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hSA] using hfc)

/-- Real normalized bounded Bernstein MGF, with almost-sure one-sided cap. -/
theorem centered_bounded_matrix_mgf
    {Ω : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hintX : Integrable X μ)
    (hintSq : Integrable (fun ω => X ω * X ω) μ)
    (hherm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hcap : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (1 - X ω).PosSemidef)
    (hzero : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (NormedSpace.exp ((Real.exp s - s - 1) • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)) -
      ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
 := by
  classical
  let M := Matrix ι ι ℝ
  let g : ℝ := Real.exp s - s - 1
  let C : M := g • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)
  have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : M → M) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hmeasExp : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ :=
    hcontExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hX.const_smul s)
  have hintExp : Integrable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hmeasExp (Real.exp s)
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact capped_matrix_exp_norm_le _ hh hc hs
  have hsqPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω * X ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm] with ω hh
    have heq : Matrix.conjTranspose (X ω) = X ω := hh
    simpa only [heq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (X ω)
  have hcovPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      (fun ω => X ω * X ω) hintSq hsqPSD
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := by dsimp only [g]; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp s]
  have hCPSD : C.PosSemidef := hcovPSD.smul hg
  let Q : Ω → M := fun ω => (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω)
  let F : Ω → M := fun ω => Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)
  have hintOne : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (1 : M)) μ := integrable_const _
  have honeMean : (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) = 1 := by simp
  have hintQ : Integrable Q μ := (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)).add (hintSq.smul g)
  have hintF : Integrable F μ := hintQ.sub hintExp
  have hQmean : (∫ ω, Q ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C := by
    dsimp only [Q, C]
    have hsum :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using
        integral_add (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)) (hintSq.smul g)
    have hsumOne :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) =
          (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, s • X ω ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using integral_add hintOne (hintX.smul s)
    rw [hsum, hsumOne, integral_smul s X,
      integral_smul g (fun ω => X ω * X ω), honeMean, hzero]
    simp only [smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hFmean : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ := by
    change (∫ ω, Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) = _
    rw [integral_sub hintQ hintExp, hQmean]
  have hFPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (F ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinExponential.bernstein_exponential_quadratic_bound
      (X ω) hh hc hs
  have hupperPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      F hintF hFPSD
  rw [hFmean] at hupperPSD
  have hlowerPSD := exp_sub_one_add_posSemidef C hCPSD.isHermitian
  change (NormedSpace.exp C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
  have halg : NormedSpace.exp C - (∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) =
      (NormedSpace.exp C - (1 + C)) +
        ((1 + C) - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) := by abel
  rw [halg]
  exact hlowerPSD.add hupperPSD

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinMgf

assumptions: Public scope: a probability space \((\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)\), a finite nonempty index set \(\mathcal I\), and a real random square matrix \(X:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\). The integral is Bochner integration and \(e^A\) is the matrix-algebra power series. The order \(U\preceq V\) means that \(V-U\) is positive semidefinite as a full quadratic form.

Public hypotheses: \(X=X^\top\) and \(X\preceq I\) almost surely, \(\int X\,d\mu=0\), and \(s>0\). The cap is one-sided. The matrix need not be positive semidefinite and negative eigenvalues are unrestricted.

Explicit source-standing regularity: \(X\) is almost-everywhere strongly measurable, \(\int\|X\|\,d\mu<\infty\), and \(\int\|X^2\|\,d\mu<\infty\). These make Tropp§2.2's sufficiently-regular expectation convention explicit for the actual first and second matrix expectations. The exponential integrability needed in the proof is derived from the cap.

\(X^2=X\cdot X\) is the ordinary matrix square. The exponent uses its actual matrix expectation \(\int X^2\,d\mu\), with coefficient \(e^s-s-1\). No scalar variance proxy or matrix covariance upper cover replaces that expectation.

lesson.title: Centered bounded real matrix MGF
lesson.statement: A centered self-adjoint real random matrix with upper cap identity satisfies an individual matrix MGF bound for every positive parameter.
assumptions: Public scope: a probability space \((\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)\), a finite nonempty index set \(\mathcal I\), and a real random square matrix \(X:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\). The integral is Bochner integration and \(e^A\) is the matrix-algebra power series. The order \(U\preceq V\) means that \(V-U\) is positive semidefinite as a full quadratic form.

Public hypotheses: \(X=X^\top\) and \(X\preceq I\) almost surely, \(\int X\,d\mu=0\), and \(s>0\). The cap is one-sided. The matrix need not be positive semidefinite and negative eigenvalues are unrestricted.

Explicit source-standing regularity: \(X\) is almost-everywhere strongly measurable, \(\int\|X\|\,d\mu<\infty\), and \(\int\|X^2\|\,d\mu<\infty\). These make Tropp§2.2's sufficiently-regular expectation convention explicit for the actual first and second matrix expectations. The exponential integrability needed in the proof is derived from the cap.

\(X^2=X\cdot X\) is the ordinary matrix square. The exponent uses its actual matrix expectation \(\int X^2\,d\mu\), with coefficient \(e^s-s-1\). No scalar variance proxy or matrix covariance upper cover replaces that expectation.

Private application: \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), \(r=q+1\), \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), and \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_d=N(0,I_d)\). Every expectation below uses this original unconditional law. The case \(q=0\) is retained.

For source rows \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_b(i))_{b=0}^q\), \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Lean uses source index \(i.val+1\).

Set \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\), \(M_i=\int Y_i\,d\mu\), \(Z_i=Y_i-M_i\), \(\rho=2r(L+1)/d\), \(w_i=\cos((2q+1)\theta_i)\), and \(X_i=\rho^{-1}w_iZ_i\). The cutoff includes equality, and the paired matrix index has Gaussian coordinate first and feature coordinate second.

The private consumer has only the dimensional premise \(2q+1<d\). It derives \(\rho>0\), regularity, centering, self-adjointness and the cap internally. The deterministic cosine can be negative; its absolute value is controlled by1. The positive Laplace parameter \(s\) is distinct from the grid angles \(\theta_i\).
lesson.reader_note: The first three steps prove the public individual-MGF bound. The last three give its complete private cosine-weighted original-Gaussian application under the same unconditional law.

steps.title: Control the exponential on one self-adjoint spectrum
steps.text: For a self-adjoint A≼I, the spectrum lies below1. On that same spectrum, exp(sx)≤exp(s), so continuous functional calculus bounds the matrix exponential norm. A second scalar comparison, 1+x≤exp(x), gives I+H≼exp(H) for a self-adjoint H. Both arguments compare scalar functions of one fixed matrix.
steps.formula: A\preceq I,\ s>0\ \Longrightarrow\ \|e^{sA}\|\le e^s,\qquad H=H^\top\ \Longrightarrow\ I+H\preceq e^H.

    cfc_mono (a := A) (fun x _ => by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x])
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hlin : cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) A = (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) + A := by
    rw [cfc_add (a := A) (fun _ : ℝ => 1) (fun x : ℝ => x) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      cfc_const (R := ℝ) 1 A hSA, cfc_id' ℝ A hSA, map_one]
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mp
    (by simpa only [hlin, CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hSA] using hfc)

steps.title: Make the actual matrix expectations well-defined
steps.text: Write g=exp(s)−s−1 and C=g EμX². Continuity of the matrix exponential and the cap bound give its measurability and integrability under the probability law. Since X is self-adjoint, X²=XᵀX is positive semidefinite almost surely. The canonical positive-integral theorem and g≥0 therefore make C positive semidefinite, hence self-adjoint. The assumed integrability of X and X² also makes the quadratic majorant and its difference from exp(sX) integrable.
steps.formula: \|e^{sX}\|\le e^s\ \mu\text{-a.e.},\quad X^2=X^\top X\succeq0,\quad g=e^s-s-1\ge0,\quad C=g\,\mathbb E_\mu X^2\succeq0.

/-- Real normalized bounded Bernstein MGF, with almost-sure one-sided cap. -/
theorem centered_bounded_matrix_mgf
    {Ω : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hintX : Integrable X μ)
    (hintSq : Integrable (fun ω => X ω * X ω) μ)
    (hherm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hcap : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (1 - X ω).PosSemidef)
    (hzero : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (NormedSpace.exp ((Real.exp s - s - 1) • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)) -
      ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
 := by
  classical
  let M := Matrix ι ι ℝ
  let g : ℝ := Real.exp s - s - 1
  let C : M := g • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)
  have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : M → M) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hmeasExp : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ :=
    hcontExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hX.const_smul s)
  have hintExp : Integrable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hmeasExp (Real.exp s)
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact capped_matrix_exp_norm_le _ hh hc hs
  have hsqPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω * X ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm] with ω hh
    have heq : Matrix.conjTranspose (X ω) = X ω := hh
    simpa only [heq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (X ω)
  have hcovPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      (fun ω => X ω * X ω) hintSq hsqPSD
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := by dsimp only [g]; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp s]
  have hCPSD : C.PosSemidef := hcovPSD.smul hg
  let Q : Ω → M := fun ω => (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω)
  let F : Ω → M := fun ω => Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)
  have hintOne : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (1 : M)) μ := integrable_const _
  have honeMean : (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) = 1 := by simp
  have hintQ : Integrable Q μ := (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)).add (hintSq.smul g)
  have hintF : Integrable F μ := hintQ.sub hintExp

steps.title: Integrate the quadratic majorant and cancel the first moment
steps.text: Apply the existing canonical exponential-quadratic bound to X(ω) almost surely. Positivity of Bochner integration preserves its PSD difference. Linearity, μ(Ω)=1 and EμX=0 turn the expected majorant into I+C. Finally add the PSD differences exp(C)−(I+C) and (I+C)−Eμexp(sX). This gives the complete real normalized individual-MGF comparison with the actual second moment.
steps.formula: \mathbb E_\mu e^{sX}\preceq I+s\mathbb E_\mu X+g\mathbb E_\mu X^2=I+C\preceq e^C,\qquad e^C-\mathbb E_\mu e^{sX}=(e^C-I-C)+(I+C-\mathbb E_\mu e^{sX})\succeq0.

have hQmean : (∫ ω, Q ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C := by
    dsimp only [Q, C]
    have hsum :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using
        integral_add (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)) (hintSq.smul g)
    have hsumOne :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) =
          (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, s • X ω ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using integral_add hintOne (hintX.smul s)
    rw [hsum, hsumOne, integral_smul s X,
      integral_smul g (fun ω => X ω * X ω), honeMean, hzero]
    simp only [smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hFmean : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ := by
    change (∫ ω, Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) = _
    rw [integral_sub hintQ hintExp, hQmean]
  have hFPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (F ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinExponential.bernstein_exponential_quadratic_bound
      (X ω) hh hc hs
  have hupperPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      F hintF hFPSD
  rw [hFmean] at hupperPSD
  have hlowerPSD := exp_sub_one_add_posSemidef C hCPSD.isHermitian
  change (NormedSpace.exp C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
  have halg : NormedSpace.exp C - (∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) =
      (NormedSpace.exp C - (1 + C)) +
        ((1 + C) - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) := by abel
  rw [halg]
  exact hlowerPSD.add hupperPSD

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinMgf

private lemma one_sub_posSemidef_of_norm_le_one
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hn : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) :
    (1 - A).PosSemidef := by
  have hspec : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    exact (Real.le_norm_self x).trans
      ((IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus.norm_spectrum_le A hx hA.isSelfAdjoint).trans hn)
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mp ((CFC.le_one_iff (R := ℝ) A hA.isSelfAdjoint).mpr hspec)

private theorem actual_source_weighted_normalized_single_summand_mgf
        {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let X : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => ρ⁻¹ • (w i • Z i ω)
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ i : Fin d,
    (NormedSpace.exp
        ((Real.exp s - s - 1) • (∫ ω, X i ω * X i ω ∂μ)) -
      ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X i ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let X : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => ρ⁻¹ • (w i • Z i ω)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  letI : MeasurableSpace M := borel M
  letI : BorelSpace M := ⟨rfl⟩
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by
    dsimp only [μ]
    infer_instance
  change ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ i : Fin d,
    (NormedSpace.exp ((Real.exp s - s - 1) • (∫ ω, X i ω * X i ω ∂μ)) -
      ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X i ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
  have radius :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius.actual_source_truncated_matrix_norm_bounds
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y j ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ‖mean j‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ)) at radius
  have hstructure :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixStructure.actual_source_centered_matrix_structure
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, Measurable (Z j)) ∧ iIndepFun Z μ ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (Z j) μ) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, (∫ ω, Z j ω ∂μ) = 0) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, (Z j ω).IsHermitian) at hstructure
  rcases hstructure with ⟨hmeasZ, _, hintZ, hzeroZ, hhermZ⟩
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  have hd2R : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd2
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith)
  have hLpos : 0 < L + 1 := by dsimp only [L]; nlinarith
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by dsimp only [ρ]; positivity
  have hnormZ (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : ‖Z j ω‖ ≤ ρ := by
    change ‖Y j ω - mean j‖ ≤ ρ
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖Y j ω‖ + ‖mean j‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ) + 2 * r / (d : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (radius.1 j ω) (radius.2 j)
      _ = ρ := by dsimp only [ρ]; ring

steps.title: Control the signed cosine through the norm cap
steps.text: The deterministic weight w_i=cos((2q+1)θ_i) can be negative, but |w_i|≤1. Multiply norms to obtain ‖w_iZ_i‖≤ρ and then normalize by the already positive ρ. Real scalar multiplication preserves self-adjointness. The resulting Hermitian norm cap implies X_i≼I through the spectral adapter. No one-sided matrix inequality is multiplied by a possibly negative cosine.

have hnormW (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : ‖w j • Z j ω‖ ≤ ρ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hw : |w j| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one _
    calc
      |w j| * ‖Z j ω‖ ≤ 1 * ρ :=
        mul_le_mul hw (hnormZ j ω) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = ρ := one_mul _
  have hnormX (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : ‖X j ω‖ ≤ 1 := by
    change ‖ρ⁻¹ • (w j • Z j ω)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hρpos)]
    calc
      _ ≤ ρ⁻¹ * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnormW j ω) (inv_nonneg.mpr hρpos.le)
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρpos)
  have hhermX (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (X j ω).IsHermitian := by
    change (ρ⁻¹ • (w j • Z j ω)).IsHermitian
    exact ((IsSelfAdjoint.all (ρ⁻¹ : ℝ)).smul
      ((IsSelfAdjoint.all (w j)).smul (hhermZ j ω).isSelfAdjoint)).isHermitian
  have hcapX (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (1 - X j ω).PosSemidef :=
    one_sub_posSemidef_of_norm_le_one _ (hhermX j ω) (hnormX j ω)
